amendment_majority_post_fix.note: Threshold once fixAmendmentMajorityCalc activates; used by AmendmentSet::computeThreshold (src/xrpld/app/misc/detail/AmendmentTable.cpp:328-341).

amendment_majority_pre_fix.note: Legacy threshold; 204/256 = 79.6875%, used while fixAmendmentMajorityCalc is inactive.

amendment_majority_time_weeks.note: defaultAmendmentMajorityTime = 2 weeks; an amendment must hold a majority for this long.

flag_ledger_interval.note: isFlagLedger(seq) is true when seq % 256 == 0 (src/xrpld/app/ledger/Ledger.cpp:981-984). Fee and amendment pseudo-transactions are voted only at flag ledgers (src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:363-379).

negative_unl_50pct_ledgers.note: FLAG_LEDGER_INTERVAL * 50 / 100 — a validator missing this many flag ledgers is a negative-UNL candidate.

negative_unl_min_local_vals.note: FLAG_LEDGER_INTERVAL * 90 / 100 — minimum local validations in the last flag-ledger period for the local node to participate in negative-UNL voting.

reference_fee_drops.note: FeeSetup::reference_fee, the cost of a reference transaction in drops. This is a PER-TRANSACTION base fee, not a per-ledger figure.

validator_quorum_floor_fraction.note: AbsoluteMinimumQuorum: effective quorum never below 60% of the original UNL size (negative-UNL protocol).

validator_quorum_fraction.note: calculateQuorum returns max(ceil(effectiveUnlSize * 0.67), ceil(unlSize * 0.6)). Comment states upstream XRPL uses 80% but this fork uses 67% for devnet/testnet and mainnet should revert to 80%.
